units.landmarks_image: x, y in 0..1 of frame width/height; z relative depth
units.fingers.curl: degrees, bigger = more folded (a straight finger reads ~25-60, a fist ~200-250)

handedness_note: MediaPipe labels handedness as if the image were mirrored (selfie). For a normal, non-mirrored teacher video a right hand is reported as 'Left'.
